title: A New Home for Research, Tools, and Notes
text:
This site is a place to collect my research, publications, reusable code, teaching material, and short notes on marine ecology, climate change, conservation planning, and reproducible data science.
Over time, I plan to use this space for:

plain-language summaries of new papers
reusable R workflows
workshop material
project notes
reflections on conservation science and career transitions

The goal is simple: make the work easier to find, understand, reuse, and share.

title: Dr Isaac Brito-Morales
text:
I study how climate change reshapes biodiversity in the ocean, and I build reproducible analyses that help conservation decisions travel from data to action.

View publications Download CV

title: Dr Isaac Brito-Morales
text:
What I Work On
I am a marine ecologist and conservation scientist focused on species redistribution, marine climate exposure, conservation planning, and open, reproducible workflows in R.
My work connects global environmental datasets, ecological theory, and practical conservation needs, with a particular interest in how ocean dynamics shape biodiversity patterns and climate adaptation.
